gates.frame: course world frame (x east, y north, z up), pole xyz is the pole base on the snow
gates.rules: Pass each gate between turn_pole and outer_pole. side = which side of the centerline the gate sits on (as seen skiing downhill). panel_normal faces uphill toward the skier.

start.note: yaw is CCW from +x (east) and points down the course. quat_surface aligns the root x axis with the course heading and z with the snow normal (skis flat on the snow). make_scene adds a robot-specific root position for that robot under robots/<name>.

sources.elevation: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium), see README for attribution
